vagas.title: Planner RJ
vagas.description: Overview Na V3A, a cultura aparece nas escolhas que fazemos: o que priorizamos, como decidimos e o nível de resultado que esperamos entregar. Acreditamos em performance com responsabilidade, autonomia com atitude e crescimento baseado em resultados, bem como a prevalência de times foda! Valorizamos quem assume o protagonismo e joga para ganhar, sempre respeitando nossos acordos, processos e, principalmente, pessoas. Nossa régua é alta, engloba escolhas assertivas, excelência na execução e prioridade à experiência de marca dos nossos steakholders. Responsabilidades Estamos com uma vaga aberta de Planner e se você busca desafios únicos, autonomia, um ambiente focado em impacto (sem deixar de lado a criatividade), e processos alinhados, essa vaga é para você! Desenvolver narrativas e storytelling criativos para os projetos, traduzindo ideias em uma apresentação comercial impactante e alinhada com as necessidades do cliente. Criar ativações inovadoras, transformando conceitos criativos em experiências memoráveis. Olhar estratégico de marketing, garantindo que o desenvolvimento da ação atenda às métricas estabelecidas, como engajamento, visibilidade e retorno de investimento. Pesquisa de tendências e insights do mercado para inovação contínua nos projetos. Gestão de cronogramas e prazos, garantindo que todas as etapas dos projetos sejam entregues de acordo com os prazos acordados e os processos internos da agência e do cliente. Atuação colaborativa com a direção de arte, atendimento e produção, alinhando as expectativas criativas com as viabilidades financeiras e práticas do projeto. Garantir a entrega de soluções criativas viáveis que atendam às expectativas do cliente dentro do orçamento e dos prazos estipulados. Participação ativa em brainstorms, trazendo ideias inovadoras e estratégicas para campanhas e eventos. Execução de outras atividades relacionadas, conforme orientação da liderança. Qualificações Profissional com experiência em planejamento criativo e desenvolvimento conceitual de eventos e ações de live marketing. Formação em Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Domínio em ferramentas de apresentação, como Power Point. Comunicação verbal e escrita afiada, com facilidade para estruturar e defender conceitos e ideias. Proatividade e autonomia, sabendo gerir demandas e prioridades com inteligência e eficiência. Benefícios Ambiente dinâmico e descontraído. Horário flexível (híbrido). Formato de contratação PJ. Honorários compatíveis com o mercado. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Estagiário(a) de Desenvolvimento - Back-end
vagas.description: Sobre a OceanPact A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar. Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos. Sobre a vaga Estamos em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) de Desenvolvimento Back‑end para atuar em uma equipe multidisciplinar que desenvolve uma plataforma Web/PWA para resposta a emergência e exploração sustentável dos oceanos, envolvendo visualização e processamento de dados (históricos, tempo real e previstos) em conjunto com um mapa interativo. Responsabilidades Participar do processo de manter arquiteturas de software robustas; Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e sustentação de funcionalidades existentes em um contexto de agilidade; Colaborar com outras equipes (Frontend, DevOps, QA) para integrar soluções completas e eficientes. Requisitos Obrigatórios: Cursando Ensino Superior em Sistemas da Informação, Ciências da Computação ou áreas afins, a partir do 3º período; Conhecimento em pacote office; Conhecimento em estruturas de dados e algoritmos; Conhecimento em engenharia de software: versionamento, code review, design de APIs REST; Conhecimento em linguagem de programação (especialmente Python); Conhecimento sobre bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais. Desejáveis: Conhecimento em: CI/CD e automação de deploys, além de experiência com ambientes de Cloud, preferencialmente Azure; Conhecimento de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, utilizando conceitos como Design Patterns, SOLID e Clean Code; Familiaridade com frameworks web como Flask e FastAPI, bem como com testes automatizados, incluindo testes unitários e de integração; Familiaridade com bibliotecas de processamento de dados, como Pandas e Xarray, além de experiência com a linguagem de programação Go; Vivência em domínios náuticos, geoespaciais ou ambientais. vagas.description: Registro no COREN RJ ativo e em regularidade. Desejável vivência anterior com as rotinas de unidade intensiva ou semi intensiva.Atividades: Cumprir os protocolos de assistência criados pela unidade, aplicando todas as medidas preventivas específicas, visando garantir a segurança do paciente. Conferir e repor o carro e maleta de PCR, após a utilização em situações emergenciais, a fim de garantir sua prontidão para novas situações. Fazer conferência mensal dos materiais permanentes e consignados (VALIDADE). Contactar equipe médica e anestesistas sobre procedimentos eletivos e emergências. Preparar sala e mesas para exames e/ou cirurgias; Separar os materiais necessários e auxiliar os médicos nos procedimentos realizados, tais como: Cateterismo Cardíaco, Angioplastia (coronariana e vascular), Arteriografias (cerebral, renal, pulmonar, medular, mesentérica, MMII e MMSS, Drenagem Biliar, Colocação de Filtro de Veia Cava e PICC, Embolização Cerebral, Quimoembolização (hepáticas, uterinas e mesentéricas), Estudo Eletrofisiológico + Ablação, Aortografia. Utilizar EPIs específicos: capote de chumbo, protetor de tireoide, óculos plumbífero, dosímetro, (sala de Hemodinâmica chumbada com aparelho de intensificador de Raio X). -Verificar os pacientes em precaução de contato, assegurando o bloqueio de entrada, com uso correto e rigoroso de EPIs.; Apresentar-se aos pacientes sob sua responsabilidade em sala, prestando todas as informações necessárias a continuidade de seu exame. Confirmar e checar JEJUM, ALERGIA, especificamente à IÔDO com o paciente. Receber e preparar o paciente na sala de Hemodinâmica. Identificação do paciente no livro de sala com número de exame, médico que realizará o procedimento, horários de início e término. Cuidados de enfermagem: posicionamento do paciente na mesa de exame, monitorização (Sapo², F.C, F.R, PNI, PAM, Temperatura., Co²), punção venosa periférica, sondagem vesical, aspiração orotraqueal, oxigenioterapia, administração de medicamentos, assepsia e antissepsia.Cobrança de folha dos materiais utilizados em sala durante os exames. Prestar vigilância intensiva aos pacientes sob seus cuidados em sala, registrando na evolução qualquer intercorrência, para fins de controle.Outras informações: Local de trabalho: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro - RJ #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Driller - Brazil
vagas.description: The Driller is the onsite focal point for all well operations and Main Deck activities, under the overall control of the Rig Superintendent, and is responsible for supervising onsite well operations activities, and for ensuring that the operation is completed safely & efficiently in accordance with the approved program and Company policies & procedures. The Driller will be conversant with all statutory requirements relating to Well Control and Well Intervention, with all personnel directly or indirectly involved with well operations conforming to the instructions issued by them. Duties & Responsibilities Coordinate, when needed, the Deck Supervisor on his supervision of the deck crew and 3rd Party/vendors on deck Liaise with the Tool Pusher and On Shift Client Representative regarding any changes to the approved well program and communicate these requested changes to all personnel working under their supervision. As delegate of the Rig Superintendent/ Tool Pusher, secure the well in emergency situations and always be aware of environmental aspects. Ensure that the Tool Pusher, Rig Superintendent and Client are advised of all current and/or changing conditions. Under instruction from the Tool Pusher they will conduct Emergency Disconnection Drill to ensure that all personnel are familiar with these operations and record the results in the Operations Daily report. First line is responsible for carrying out the well control and EDS procedures in situations of need emergency disconnect. Under instruction from the Tool pusher usher and or Rig Superintendent they will conduct Well Control Drills. Ensure that well control equipment is correctly maintained, installed and pressure tested. Take direction from the Tool Pusher in all Well Control Operations. Ensure that they have full understanding of the vessel's Well Control Philosophy that includes the current HdB Policies on Well Control & Barriers. Request written dispensation from the tool pusher for any operations that cannot be carried out under the Helix Well Control & Barrier Policies. Conduct Pre-shift, TBT’s, TOFS, Daily drills, & weekly safety meetings with their crew. Ensure that Helix Health & Safety policies are communicated to and understood by all crew members. Ensure that all Supervisors communicate through toolbox meetings, all operational safety aspects of the 12-hour shift. In conjunction with the Tool pusher ensure vessel Well Operations Personnel are being trained to meet the company’s training matrix requirements. Ensure that the appropriate logs and records are maintained throughout their shift. As part of the Offshore Management Team, meet daily to discuss previous 24 hours and ongoing operations. As part of the Offshore Management Team, meet as and when situations dictate, they are required. Be responsible for the adherence to Helix and Client safety & PPE policies by all personnel working on deck. Be responsible for the adherence to Helix & Statutory Lifting procedures and requirements by all personnel under his supervision. Record all relevant operational information (including but not limited to tool string and subsea equipment data, dimensions, hanging weights, overpulls etc.). They will ensure that this data is readily available in the doghouse throughout the project as required and officially recorded in their daily operational log. Be competent to operate the MPT and associated MPT systems. Directly supervise & record the opening and closing of the Intervention System and Subsea Tree. Ensure, on an ongoing basis, that all parties under their supervision have clear and effective lines of communication as required, and will ensure that operations do not commence until this is in place and confirmed. Ensure that operations are carried out in accordance with the latest instruction issued by the OMT with reference to the project documentation where required, and that all personnel under their supervision are clear as regards their role in the forward operation. Complete appraisal for all members of their crew & ensure that it is given to the Tool Pusher or Rig superintendent prior to their departure at the end of each trip. Instigate weekly DROPS inspections, ensuring actions are corrected, reported & logged in the DROPS register. Assist the vessel Maintenance team & Chief Engineer to maintain vessel equipment. Review and as required, perform all safety control duties as per rig´s specific HSE Case, Safety Case, HAZOP and JSAs. Perform, respecting any applicable license limitation and under supervision, similar responsibilities Tool Pusher for training, qualification and temporary coverage purposes. Perform, if required, the same duties as the Assistant Driller. QHSE Following and complying with all the company's health, safety and environment policies, objectives/targets and procedures Minimum Qualifications Requirements High school diploma or equivalent. Minimum 3 experience effectively working as a Driller or equivalent in well intervention projects. Qualification As per Helix training and competence directives. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Technical Product Manager
vagas.description: You are a delivery-oriented Senior Product Manager who thrives in cross-functional environments where strategic thinking, clear communication, and hands-on execution go hand in hand. You are comfortable bringing structure to complex backlogs, driving alignment across distributed teams, and operating independently within high-expectation consulting environments. You bring a proactive and execution-focused mindset, capable of owning sprint delivery end-to-end while balancing roadmap priorities, stakeholder communication, and product execution. You are confident facilitating Agile ceremonies, managing competing priorities, and translating product strategy into actionable backlog items and measurable outcomes. You also actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve documentation quality, accelerate delivery, streamline collaboration, and support rapid product iteration. You thrive in environments where adaptability, accountability, and continuous improvement are highly valued. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Strong Agile/Scrum fluency, including backlog refinement, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition. Proven experience managing product delivery across ideation, design handoff, development, UAT, release planning, and post-deployment activities. Proven ability to translate product strategy into structured multi-quarter roadmaps and prioritized backlogs. Experience facilitating collaboration across Engineering, Design, and stakeholder groups within cross-functional environments. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including presenting updates, priorities, and risks to senior stakeholders. Proficiency with Figma for mockup reviews and design handoff collaboration. Active use of AI-assisted tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Claude Code within day-to-day product workflows. Ability to leverage AI tools for repository analysis, story generation, rapid prototyping, and workflow optimization. Background in consulting environments or experience within data-centric product organizations. (Highly desirable). Technical or coding knowledge. (Nice to have). Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal). You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Own and maintain a well-groomed backlog: detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritization aligned with engineering and business needs. Facilitate all core Scrum ceremonies and drive alignment across distributed teams within the client's delivery framework. Lead release planning, UAT, release notes, and usage reporting. Act as the primary product point of contact for the development team and senior stakeholders: regular updates on progress, risks, and priorities. Triage bugs and enhancement requests; manage intake, prioritization, and assignment. Support user interviews and discovery; synthesize findings into backlog recommendations. Ramp into multi-quarter roadmap and strategic prioritization responsibilities as engagement matures. Leverage AI tools actively to improve documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and delivery speed. Qualifications Strong experience with Agile/Scrum delivery and backlog ownership. Experience managing product delivery across the full SDLC. Proficiency with Figma and cross-functional product collaboration. Active use of AI tools within product management workflows. Advanced English proficiency. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Neste contexto a AVSI irá operacionalizar um projeto no Municipio do Rio de Janeiro e em algumas áreas da baixada fluminense, com objetivo de mobilização social, organização comunitária e atividades correlatas, visando ao engajamento e a integração das comunidades nos municípios de atuação da empresa que são localizados no estado do Rio de Janeiro, com predominância nas regiões metropolitanas e capital. O foco está na sensibilização sobre as atividades sociais da empresa através de momentos educativos, alinhando transparência, inclusão e bem-estar da população atendida. Poderão ser promovidos eventos, com objetivo de ativar outros parceiros, para consolidar a relação de confiança entre a empresa e a população local, criando marketing positivo e desenvolvimento das comunidades. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Gerente de Projeto será responsável pela gestão integral do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento das diretrizes contratuais e dos procedimentos da AVSI. Essa função abrange a coordenação completa do ciclo do projeto, integrando aspectos gerenciais e administrativos, com responsabilidade final pelo planejamento e execução das atividades, gerenciamento da equipe dedicada, mobilização das comunidades, suporte técnico e administrativo, além do desenvolvimento de metodologias de controle e logística para assegurar a execução eficiente e os resultados esperados. Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI. Organizar as atividades do projeto nos seus aspectos operacionais e administrativos, apresentando relatórios ao responsável preposto. Auxiliar na solicitação de compras previstas no Plano de Aquisição aprovado, garantindo a correta descrição de bens e serviços para o setor de aquisições. Selecionar, coordenar, supervisionar, monitorar e avaliar a equipe técnica do programa. Aplicar rigorosamente os procedimentos e regras estabelecidos nos manuais da AVSI. Manter atualizado o arquivo de documentos no sistema de PATRIMONIALIZAÇÃO da AVSI. Enviar periodicamente ao setor de Comunicação materiais sobre o projeto para publicação. Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto. Representar a AVSI no diálogo e na relação técnica com a equipe da contratante. About The Role You own the full development cycle for the features and systems your team assigns you. At Landmark, that means working on software that oil and gas operators depend on for high‑stakes decisions. You take a feature from specification through design, implementation, testing, and delivery with minimal supervision and enough judgment to make good technical decisions along the way. The quality of what you build shows up in production software used by operators worldwide. Strong software engineering fundamentals are the primary requirement. Domain knowledge is valuable but can develop on the job. Positions are available across a range of teams. Team assignment determines both the product domain you work in and the major technologies you use. optimization E&P data management and integration Cloud and platform infrastructure, data services, and developer tooling AI-assisted analytics, search, and generative AI Technologies Used Vary By Team And Include Languages such as Java, C#, F#, C++, Python, and TypeScript Frameworks, platforms, and runtimes such as .NET, Eclipse RCP/SWT, JUnit, Angular, React, and Node.js Cloud platforms including Azure and AWS Containerization and orchestration tooling such as Docker and Kubernetes Infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and Argo CD/Flux Relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, and MongoDB Job Duties Own features end to end: analyze requirements, design solutions, write the code, test it, and ship it Break complex specifications into concrete tasks with realistic schedules and flag risks early Proactively identify and fix weaknesses in the codebase, the test coverage, and the development process Investigate and resolve production defects, and trace root cause when symptom and source are not in the same place Apply secure coding practices, surface vulnerabilities in code reviews, and fix security issues as they arise Review code from other engineers with the same rigor you expect on your own work Evaluate and integrate open‑source tools and libraries where they improve the systems you work on Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, and direct technical guidance Communicate clearly across a distributed, cross‑timezone team Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software causes that span multiple components or layers Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade‑offs to teammates and stakeholders Preferred Experience with cloud‑native development, full‑stack or web application development, or data platform technologies Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation Background in enterprise software, SaaS platforms, or technically demanding application domains (scientific computing, real‑time systems, large‑scale data) Exposure to integrating machine learning, generative AI, or LLM‑based components into application features Experience mentoring less experienced engineers Energy industry experience is not required but is a strong plus. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every item in the preferred list. How You Work The engineer who succeeds in this role brings independent judgment to their work and applies it consistently. You own your assignments end to end, communicate clearly when something is off track, and treat code reviews as a genuine quality tool rather than a formality. You are comfortable working across time zones, adaptable when requirements shift, and focused on delivery outcomes rather than task completion. You pick up new tools and techniques on your own, evaluate them critically, and bring the ones that work to your team. You help the engineers around you improve because you understand that team quality compounds over time. Why Landmark We build small, high‑ownership teams and invest in the quality of every person on them. You will work in a business where software is the product, the work you do matters, and the standards are high. You will own real work that ships, learn from engineers who push you, and grow into the kind of engineer the team relies on. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Auxiliar o nutricionista nas atividades de gerenciamento da unidade e orientar funcionários no preparo e distribuição de alimentos. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. vagas.title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
vagas.description: Overview FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department Technical & Infrastructure Location Brazil Position Summary The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires an outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world‑class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards. The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly oversee the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding, and non‑competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums. Key Responsibilities Oversee the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during the planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament. Collaborate with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensure that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Work closely with the Non‑Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project. Serve as the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department. Oversee contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites. Constantly monitor the budgetary impact of dressing operations and report updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. Provide strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offer expertise when required. Adhere to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Maintain daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaise with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Present to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required. Attend department‑specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites. Input into the site‑specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management. Act as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project. Participate in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites. Assist with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensure the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites. Contribute to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Possibly relocate to a Host City for up to three months to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. Your Profile Minimum 4+ years of experience delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games, etc., or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.). Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large‑scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi‑faceted events and projects. Experience managing providers of services for world‑class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) in Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. Readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs, as the role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems. Will attend site visits and be away from home for periods of time, including on‑site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written). Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written). Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: A CARREIRA DO FARMACÊUTICO DE ASSUNTOS REGULATÓRIOS
vagas.description: A carreira farmacêutica especializada em regulação sanitária de indústrias, distribuidoras e empresas do varejo farmacêutico é uma das mais valorizadas pelo mercado de trabalho. Esta carreira possui grande projeção profissional no meio industrial e em órgãos reguladores, em que existe maior complexidade nas atividades realizadas pelo profissional, consequentemente as maiores remunerações estão em localidades que possuem polos industriais farmacêuticos, como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, Brasília e Pernambuco. Ser especialista em regulação sanitária exige do profissional aptidão para tarefas administrativas, conhecimentos aprofundados em legislação sanitária nacional e internacional e capacidade de negociação, liderança, comunicação e gestão. O inglês é indispensável e o espanhol pode ser um diferencial para grandes empresas farmacêuticas brasileiras, que detêm filiais na América Latina. A competição profissional nesta carreira é acirrada, pois a atuação não é restrita ao farmacêutico por força de lei. Dessa forma, o profissional formado em Farmácia compete com praticamente todos os profissionais de saúde, advogados e até administradores de empresas. Responsabilidades na indústria de medicamentos e em consultorias especializadas: Acompanha os processos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Analisa relatórios de qualificação e validação; Acompanha e avalia o mercado e os lançamentos de novos produtos dos concorrentes; Administra e executa o processo de registro de novos produtos farmacêuticos na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa); Acompanha diariamente as publicações da Anvisa no Diário Oficial da União (D.O.U.); Discute novas resoluções em Consultas Públicas na Anvisa; Acompanha e implementa novas resoluções e regras sanitárias; Recebe e acompanha auditoria sanitária; Administra o processo de revalidação do registro de produtos; Acompanha o sistema de atendimento ao cliente (SAC) e registros do setor de farmacovigilância; Orienta o departamento de marketing em publicidades e propagandas; Orienta o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Verifica os registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento. Responsabilidades nos órgãos reguladores: Acompanha o cumprimento de normas e legislação por parte das empresas; Propõe e debate com o mercado o desenvolvimento de novas resoluções e regulamentações; Fiscaliza a qualidade e o seguimento de regras na produção de produtos farmacêuticos; Fiscaliza a comercialização de produtos farmacêuticos; Regulamenta o preço dos medicamentos; Regulamenta os tipos de medicamentos e suas formas de comercialização; Regulamenta o comércio farmacêutico e suas características de consumo. Orienta e acompanha o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Cuida dos registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento; Orienta e fiscaliza condições de estoque e armazenamento de produtos; Acompanha e fiscaliza condições de transporte e distribuição de produtos farmacêuticos. Áreas de atuação: Indústrias farmacêuticas; Empresas de logística farmacêutica; Consultorias especializadas; Vigilância sanitária de estados e municípios (Visa). O curso de graduação em Farmácia é o mais indicado para profissionais que desejam seguir carreira em Assuntos Regulatórios principalmente na indústria de medicamentos. É importante ressaltar que profissionais que desejam atuar em agências reguladoras, como a Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa), é necessária a aprovação em concurso público específico. O curso de graduação em Direito também têm peso e relevância. Uma especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios é obrigatória. Existe também a opção de especialização em Logística Farmacêutica para os profissionais que atuam especificamente em distribuidoras. Para que o profissional se mantenha atualizado é imprescindível que ele acesse, com periodicidade, o conteúdo específico da área farmacêutica publicado no Diário Oficial da União e o site da Anvisa, para manter-se informado sobre novas legislações e consultas públicas vigentes. O ICTQ - Instituto de Pesquisa e Pós-Graduação para o Mercado Farmacêutico tem em seu portal na internet um canal de notícias atualizado diariamente com as novidades demandadas pela Anvisa, vale a pena acompanhá-lo. O mesmo Instituto é pioneiro no Brasil com curso de especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios na Indústria Farmacêutica, além de oferecer a pós graduação em Gestão, Logística e Distribuição Farmacêutica. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio. Avaliar viabilidade e riscos: Técnicos, financeiros, produtivos e de prazo; Antecipar problemas antes de virar erro em fábrica ou campo. Responsável pelo fechamento e acompanhamento das propostas: Ciclo completo das propostas, desde a solicitação inicial até a definição da solução técnica e entrega do orçamento ao cliente e posterior follow-up, até que o ciclo do orçamento seja encerrado; Garantindo alinhamento entre escopo, orçamento, projeto e execução. vagas.title: Analista de Growth Marketing
vagas.description: DESCRIÇÃO Analista de Growth Marketing Sobre a oportunidade Buscamos um(a) Analista de Growth Marketing com perfil altamente analítico, focado em dados e orientado a resultados de alta performance. Essa posição terá papel fundamental no desenho, execução e otimização de experimentos ao longo de todo o funil de marketing e vendas, com o objetivo de acelerar a geração de demanda, otimizar investimentos e escalar a aquisição de clientes. Se você é guiado(a) por métricas, adora testar hipóteses e criar estratégias baseadas em dados para gerar tração, essa oportunidade é para você! Seu impacto aqui Planejar, executar e monitorar experimentos de Growth (testes A/B, novos canais, otimização de conversão) focados em atração e escala. Analisar o funil de growth de ponta a ponta, identificando gargalos e oportunidades de otimização desde a atração até a retenção/conversão final. Desenvolver, gerenciar e otimizar campanhas de mídia paga (Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads) com foco rigoroso em ROI e redução de CAC. Implementar estratégias de CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) em landing pages, site e fluxos de comunicação para maximizar as taxas de conversão. Estruturar automações de marketing avançadas, réguas de relacionamento e segmentações baseadas em dados de comportamento dos usuários. Acompanhar diariamente e reportar os principais KPIs da área (CAC, LTV, ROI, ROAS, taxas de conversão e volume de leads qualificados). Atuar em total sinergia com os times de Vendas e Produto/Operações para garantir o alinhamento de canais e a qualidade dos leads gerados (MQL/SQL). O que buscamos Ensino Superior completo ou em curso em Marketing, Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Experiência comprovada em Growth Marketing, Mídia Paga (Performance) ou Business Intelligence voltado para marketing. Forte domínio em ferramentas de Web Analytics (Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager) e plataformas de automação/CRM (RD Station, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign ou similares). Mentalidade de cientista: facilidade com números, raciocínio lógico apurado e paixão por rodar testes baseados em dados, não em achismos. Conhecimento prático em metodologias de teste (Frameworks de Growth, funil pirata AARRR). Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Vargem Pequena/RJ. Competências-chave Pensamento analítico e tomada de decisão baseada em dados (Data-driven). Foco agressivo em metas, resultados e otimização de performance. Agilidade para planejar, testar, errar rápido e corrigir rotas. Curiosidade intelectual e perfil autodidata para novas ferramentas e canais. Comunicação clara para traduzir dados complexos em planos de ação operacionais. vagas.title: Guest Relations Manager
vagas.description: Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Role Overview FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that will, for the first time ever, be hosted in South America in Brazil. The Guest Relations Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating and delivering Guest Relations activities for VVIP/VIP and other FIFA guest groups at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate Guest Relations activities across all guest groups, ensuring alignment with service levels and event objectives. Define and manage VVIP/VIP account management processes, including invitation, registration, communication, and quota management. Liaise with stakeholders on guest invitation concepts, guest lists, and quota definitions, including coordination with offices and embassies of international and local authorities. Map and oversee end‑to‑end guest journeys, ensuring high service standards across all touchpoints and efficient resolution of guest issues. Oversee guest requests and bookings (e.g., program attendance, ticketing, travel, accommodation, transport), including structured change‑management processes. Oversee ticketing‑related guest processes and ensure consistency and efficiency in guest request handling. Define and implement guest communication and liaison strategies, ensuring streamlined communication flows across all channels. Collaborate with FIFA Zurich and relevant departments to ensure an integrated Guest Relations approach and consistent service delivery. Establish and maintain clear communication lines with internal and external stakeholders. Develop policies, guidelines, and protocol requirements for VVIP/VIP guests and other dignitaries. Coordinate the management of guest‑related IT systems and applications in alignment with FIFA Guest Relations. Manage resources and support workforce planning for Guest Relations activities. Ensure project delivery within defined timelines, milestones, and quality standards, including reporting and issue resolution. Develop training concepts and deliver training sessions for service providers, workforce, and volunteers. Your Profile Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Communications & Marketing, International Relations, Business Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field. Specialization in protocol, event management, or international relations is an advantage. Experience: Extensive experience in guest relations and guest management, including exposure to protocol environments and structured guest handling processes. 4–6 years of experience in planning, coordinating, and delivering guest services in a professional or event‑based environment. 2–4 years of on‑site event experience in guest relations, protocol, or VVIP/VIP service delivery. Experience in managing guest accounts, invitations, registrations, and communication processes is an advantage. Experience in coordinating with high‑level stakeholders (e.g., government representatives, embassies, international organizations) is an asset. Ideally experience within a sport/event organisation or large‑scale international project, preferably in a world‑class event environment. Skills & Competencies: Fluent Portuguese and English (spoken and written) with excellent communication skills. Strong stakeholder management and relationship‑building skills. High level of diplomacy and ability to handle sensitive VVIP/VIP interactions. Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Proven problem‑solving skills and ability to operate in dynamic environments. Strong project management skills and ability to deliver under pressure. Solid understanding of guest management processes and operational coordination. Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross‑functional teams. Advanced MS Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); experience with planning tools is an asset. Certifications & Requirements: Project Management certification (e.g., PMI) or equivalent experience is an advantage. Relevant certifications in hospitality, event management, or protocol are a plus. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Software Developer, Level II - SeaPower
vagas.description: About this position Build your career with Kraken Robotics. Make a difference to others. Kraken Robotics is currently seeking a Software Developer, Level II - SeaPower . This position can be fully remote within Brazil or hybrid/in-office in Rio de Janeiro or Salvador. The Software Developer Level II will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining backend software components within Kraken’s SeaPower ecosystem. This role involves working on features and tools that support Kraken’s subsea battery systems—such as battery chargers, diagnostic applications, and simulation models for batteries and power communication systems. The position requires ownership of assigned development tasks, collaboration with cross‑functional teams, and active participation in all stages of the software development lifecycle. Operating within a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment, the Intermediate Developer will contribute to delivering reliable, high‑quality software while expanding technical skills and influencing product direction. Software Development Lifecycle: Take active ownership of assigned features through all development stages, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and documentation. Code Review & Mentorship: Participate in code reviews to maintain high-quality standards and begin providing guidance and feedback to junior developers. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, hardware teams, and other engineers to coordinate development efforts and deliver features on schedule. Test Automation & DevOps: Contribute to enhancing test coverage and improving CI/CD pipelines to support reliable and efficient software delivery. Requirements Analysis: Collaborate in refining functional and technical requirements, helping to translate them into clear, actionable development tasks. Documentation & Process Adherence: Maintain clear and up-to-date technical documentation and adhere to established software development processes and quality standards. Qualifications and Experience Educational Background Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Nice to have: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical fields. Professional Experience 3-6 years’ experience with high-level device software development, tools, and practices. Strong proficiency in Linux-based system development. Strong knowledge of modern C++ (C++14/17/20), STL, and object-oriented design. Experience writing automated tests: unit, integration and end-to-end. Familiarity with build systems (CMake, Make) and debugging tools (gdb, Valgrind). Experience using development tools and libraries such as Git, GTest. Familiarity with containerization using Docker. Nice to have Knowledge of basic electrical engineering concepts. Exposure to microservice development using gRPC/protobuf. Experience with Python. Familiarity with Agile Scrum methodologies. Experience with software‑hardware interaction and system‑level design. Exposure to CI/CD technologies, especially GitLab CI and/or Buildbot. Experience with Autoproj or other build systems for robotics. Experience with robotics frameworks (e.g., ROS or ROS2). Experience with simulation environments (e.g., Gazebo). Personal Skills Self‑motivated and capable of working independently. Ability to adapt to changing work environments and manage competing demands. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team environment. Willingness to Travel At least once a quarter to one of Kraken's offices if fully remote. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Subsea Engineer
vagas.description: Purpose To ensure that the offshore subsea equipment spread is operated and maintained in an efficient, organised, and controlled manner in accordance with manufacturer operating manuals and project procedures. Carry out engineering duties within the back deck / subsea department, supporting the subsea team under the direction of the senior subsea lead. Develop technical knowledge and operational awareness to become fully conversant with the senior subsea engineer role. Operate as part of the vessel crew and work under the overall authority of the Vessel Master in line with vessel command structure. Duties & Responsibilities The Subsea Engineer shall: Uphold project safety and environmental policies and ensure defects, incidents, near misses, and non-conformances are reported and investigated in line with applicable procedures. Ensure that subsea personnel and technicians work in accordance with safe systems of work, including risk assessments and control measures prior to task execution. Support supervision and coordination of subsea department personnel, maintaining discipline and compliance with applicable maritime codes of conduct. Participate in vessel emergency response duties and drills as per the Muster List. Assist with inspection, testing, and basic maintenance of vessel safety systems, including fire detection and alarm systems where required. Take responsibility for safe and efficient operation of subsea systems when acting in a supervisory capacity or in the absence of the senior subsea lead. Demonstrate full understanding of senior subsea engineer responsibilities, including launch and recovery of subsea assets and operational decision-making offshore. Ensure subsea systems are operated within approved operational and insurance limitations. Manage subsea systems during maintenance, refurbishment, or standby periods. Coordinate subsea team activities including work allocation and watchkeeping in supervisory scenarios. Support planning and execution of maintenance, repair, and overhaul of subsea equipment to ensure operational readiness at all times. Escalate system downtime or reduced functionality to vessel leadership and onshore management where required. Assist with reporting, documentation, and technical returns for subsea systems. Maintain awareness of operational factors including vessel manoeuvrability, weather conditions, currents, and seabed characteristics. Support training and development of junior technicians and subsea personnel. Undertake additional duties within the subsea engineering discipline as required by vessel or project management. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Realizar atividades de recepção, saída, organização, cadastramento, contagem, segregação e preservação de materiais e infraestrutura de armazenamento no site (ou off‑site), incluindo inventário de bens e materiais no campo das unidades de empreendimento. Realizar avaliação do certificado de completação mecânica das linhas de tubulações na FIC (ficha de integração de comissionamento). Realizar análise dos projetos de isométricos de tubulação no GED. Responsável pelo acompanhamento da programação de serviços, com análise crítica das atividades com os objetivos estratégicos do projeto, acompanhamento da execução de campo da construção e montagem, inclusive das atividades de preparação e movimentação de carga, através das programações semanais da empresa executora da obra. Realizar atividades de acompanhamento, fiscalização de campo e de contratadas bem como a aprovação/aceitação dos serviços críticos e serviços em equipamentos. Realizar atividades de fiscalização de serviços em PLC, profibuss, redes industriais, e em sistemas supervisórios (SCADA, DCS, DELTA V), controle PID, malhas de controle, instrumentação industrial (sensores, válvulas, transmissores) entre outros. Realizar a consolidação da Planilha de Composição de Custos Unitários do empreendimento (PPU). Realizar estudos de simulação de Planilhas de Demonstrativo de Formação de Preços – DFP e de Demonstrativo de Formação de BDI. Realizar análise das alíquotas de tributos dos bens e serviços. Atuar com fiscalização, em campo, para acompanhamento, ratificação e registro do avanço físico dos serviços e fornecimentos contratuais. Realizar inspeção de equipamentos em altura (NR 35). Atuar nas atividades de planejamento e acompanhamento de execução e certificação testes dos equipamentos da obra. Realizar identificação e acompanhamento de pendências de construção em montagem no SISPEN. Realizar análise de Registros de Ocorrência do contrato (RDO). Realizar controle e verificação de Relatórios de Modificações de Campo (RMC) e Relatórios de Não conformidade (RNC), utilizando a ferramenta SIGEM. Realizar controle das respostas das solicitações de informações técnicas (SIT) e das solicitações de interface (SINs). Realizar análises de impacto das mudanças de projeto, monitoramento de Indicadores de desempenho, realização de auditorias comportamentais (AUDICOMP). vagas.title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
vagas.description: This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations. We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions. The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners. At a Glance: Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe) Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments Responsibilities Production Oversight & Quality Control Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe). Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off. Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes. Inbound Logistics & Storage Management Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility. Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations. Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required. Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items. Documentation & Compliance Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork. Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing. Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals. Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes). Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions. Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers. On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team. Organize and supervise unpacking activities. Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards. Professional Experience 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects. Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes. Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred). Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations. Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination. Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus). Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously. Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance. Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable. Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards. Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows. Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints. Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures. Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports). Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs). Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience. Note: Please submit your CV in English. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: FARMACEUTICO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
vagas.description: Preparo, distribuição, dispensação e controle de medicamentos e produtos para a saúde; otimização da terapia medicamentosa; informação sobre medicamentos e produtos para a saúde; ensino, educação permanente e pesquisa. Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII) , há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em psiquiatria e obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e Atribuições Cumprir a legislação vigente relativa ao armazenamento, conservação, controle de estoque de medicamentos, produtos para a saúde, saneantes, insumos e matérias-primas, bem como as normas relacionadas com a distribuição e utilização dos mesmos. Estabelecer um sistema eficiente, eficaz e seguro de transporte e dispensação, com rastreabilidade, para pacientes em atendimento pré-hospitalar, ambulatorial ou hospitalar, podendo implementar ações de atenção farmacêutica. Participar das decisões relativas à terapia medicamentosa, tais como protocolos clínicos, protocolos de utilização de medicamentos e prescrições; supervisionar o fracionamento de medicamentos. Desenvolver e participar de ações assistenciais multidisciplinares, dentro da visão da integralidade do cuidado, interagindo com as equipes de forma interdisciplinar. Realizar ações de farmacovigilância, tecnovigilância e hemovigilância no hospital e em outros serviços de saúde, notificando as suspeitas de reações adversas e queixas técnicas, às autoridades sanitárias competentes. Promover ações de educação para o uso racional de medicamentos, produtos para a saúde e saneantes, aos demais membros da equipe de saúde. Exercer atividades de ensino, por meio de programas educacionais e de formação (treinamento e educação permanente) e programas de pós-graduação (Residência em Farmácia Hospitalar), contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de recursos humanos. Desenvolver ações de gerenciamento de riscos hospitalares, como detecção de reações adversas a medicamentos, queixas técnicas, problemas com produtos para a saúde, saneantes, kits diagnósticos e equipamentos. Prevenir e/ou detectar erros no processo de utilização de medicamentos. Zelar pelo adequado gerenciamento dos resíduos resultantes das atividades técnicas desenvolvidas nos serviços de atendimento pré-hospitalar, na farmácia hospitalar e em outros serviços de saúde, atendendo às normas sanitárias e de saúde ocupacional. Realizar e manter registros das ações farmacêuticas, observando a legislação vigente. Orientar e acompanhar, diretamente, auxiliares e técnicos de farmácia na realização de atividades nos serviços de farmácia hospitalar, treinando-os e capacitando-os para tal; a supervisão e/ou competência dessas atividades são de responsabilidade exclusiva do farmacêutico. Realizar outras atividades segundo a especificidade e a complexidade do hospital e os outros serviços de saúde. Requisitos e Qualificações Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia. Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Farmácia Clínica, Atenção Farmacêutica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe. Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Farmacêutico na área da saúde. Benefícios Alimentação no Local. Vale Alimentação. Assistência Médica (adesão facultativa). Assistência Odontológica (adesão facultativa). Disponibilizamos parcerias com Wellhub (Gympass), SESC, Zenklub, faculdades, universidades e farmácias. Auxílio Creche. Insalubridade de 20% do salário mínimo. Adicional noturno: 20% sobre a hora trabalhada, das 22h às 7h. Local de Trabalho Hospital Municipal Pedro II - CER Santa Cruz. Bairro: Santa Cruz - RJ. Escala: Plantonista Diurno (07:00 às 19:00) / Noturno 19:00 às 07:00 (12x60) ou 30 horas semanais. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: About Agoda At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. Get to Know our Team In Agoda’s Back End Engineering department, we build the scalable, fault‑tolerant systems and APIs that host our core business logic. Our systems cover all major areas of our business: inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, and more. These mission‑critical systems change frequently with dozens of releases per day, so we must employ state‑of‑the‑art CI/CD and testing techniques to make sure everything works without any downtime. We also ensure that our systems are self‑healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state‑of‑the‑art languages like Scala and Go, data technologies like Kafka and Aerospike, and agile development practices. Most importantly, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of the Back End Engineering team. The Opportunity The Engineering Manager role at Agoda is one of the most significant and challenging roles at the company. The right candidate is both extremely hands on – technically excellent, with solid engineering principles – and exhibits strong leadership and people development skills. We are looking for world class development managers to lead one or more of our engineering teams. Responsibilities Be hands on – write code, review code, and give expert level coaching and guidance to engineers. Maintain a love of engineering and passion for building things elegantly and at scale; stay current with industry trends and hold strong opinions about system architecture. Execute full‑stack engineering: have solid experience in all parts of the technology stack – infrastructure, client side, back end, performance, data, and others. Develop people: inspire those around you so they can achieve their potential; identify and integrate high‑talent hires into the business. Qualifications Extremely proficient in at least one programming language (Java, Scala, C#). Strong experience in systems architecture – particularly in complex, scalable, and fault‑tolerant distributed systems. Demonstrable experience as a system owner with operational responsibility. Proficient in lower‑level engineering (garbage collection, context switching, threading). Experience with DevOps culture – agility, leanness, automation, CI/CD. Good understanding of application security. Passionate about technology and the Internet. Have worked in a successful agile development team. Have run engineering teams before with five or more direct reports. Able to operate autonomously: make decisions, set KPIs, with a strong sense of ownership. Practice data‑driven decision making. Nice to Have Proficiency in more than one programming language. vagas.title: Jr Project Manager
vagas.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission‑critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI‑powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well‑being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Kyndryl Project Managers oversee the delivery of major projects within scope, schedule, and budget. You’ll be the driving force for every aspect of a program’s success, and the “conductor” who orchestrates everyone’s efforts to make beautiful music together. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day. As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail‑oriented calendar. You’ll be constructing detailed project plans, managing teams, and leading meetings, status calls, and planning and cadence meetings. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling. But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. Bottom line: You need to like interactions with other people and know how to be kind and empathetic but also assertive — and handle customer change requests with diplomacy. You’re going to be meeting a lot of people, networking, and forging relationships. Our “one team with the customer” concept means you’ll develop especially strong partnerships with the client and elsewhere. Some projects or clients even involve “embedding” with the client at their location. This puts more visibility on you personally, but it also gives you more opportunity to add value to the relationship. It’s a great way to hone your service and people skills, and it lays the groundwork for career growth both laterally and vertically. Your Future at Kyndryl Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well‑rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non‑technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a senior project manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of PM roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer‑focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical And Professional Experience SCRUM or Project Management skills Organization and planning skills Bachelor's degree in IT, Networking, or Business Administration MBA or postgraduate degree in project management Availability for travel Preferred Technical And Professional Experience Advanced English MS Project or other Project Management software Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid‑friendly culture that supports your well‑being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in‑demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting‑edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands‑on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Wayfinding and Signage Manager
vagas.description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. Department Technical & Infrastructure Location Brazil The Position The Wayfinding and Signage Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Wayfinding and Signage Manager is responsible for leading the wayfinding and signage implementation, operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class wayfinding and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the wayfinding and signage is up to FIFA quality standards. They will be initially responsible for the technical development of wayfinding signage guidelines and principles in collaboration with the contracted provider(s), department senior team and the other Cluster Managers. Subsequently, the candidate will be responsible for directly overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at stadiums and other official sites. In all aspects of their role, they will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations, ensuring that they are managed efficiently while monitoring budgetary spend within agreed limits. In addition, they will take guidance from other cluster managers to ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. Key Responsibilities Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. Providing expertise in assisting in the compilation of technical wayfinding signage guidelines, principles and templates. Inputting into the development of the wayfinding signage system(s) used to assist with the planning of the project. Providing strategic input into the development and implementation of the wayfinding signage kit of parts to be utilized at all official sites. Overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadiums in Brazil. Working with other Cluster Managers ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all sites within the sites. Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of allocated wayfinding operations and reporting updates to senior department members. Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaising with site owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Attending department-specific and organization site visits at both assigned sites and potentially additional official sites. Acting as the main wayfinding point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project. Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against. Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. Your Profile Relevant experience in delivering wayfinding and signage projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 4 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive wayfinding and signage related activities. Experience in devising technical guidelines and wayfinding signage kit of parts for large-scale events. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) Strong understanding of stadium wayfinding and signage requirements and large-scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects. Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education). Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on‑site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written) Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do Estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas. Descrição da Vaga Durante o período de concessão iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões, com R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga e R$ 24,4 bilhões destinados à universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, a serem alcançados nos primeiros 12 anos em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento. Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030. Compromisso com a Diversidade e Inclusão A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, estimulando o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.
